environment_audit.warning: The 40 held-out candidate items are stored in git alongside evaluation code. Model developers and agents have full read access to expected answers. Therefore, this benchmark MUST NOT be described as a clean-room blind evaluation.
environment_audit.mitigation_implemented: Blind Input Projection (project_blind_item) strips expected answers and grading criteria prior to passing inputs to model adapters.
environment_audit.future_protocol_required: True blind evaluation requires encrypting held-out items into an external enclave or clean-room container accessible only by an independent third-party auditor.
